words.example_uz: Yelkani ohista uqalash uning belidagi qotib qolishni yozdi.

words.example_en: Gargle with warm chamomile infusion three times a day.
words.example_uz: Kuniga uch marta iliq moychechak damlamasi bilan tomoqni gʻargʻara qiling.

words.example_en: Wash the hospital floor with a mild disinfectant.
words.example_uz: Shifoxona polini yumshoq dezinfeksiyalovchi vosita bilan yuving.

words.example_en: Doctors inoculate travelers against tropical fevers.
words.example_uz: Shifokorlar sayohatchilarni tropik isitmalarga qarshi emlaydilar.

words.example_en: Blood tests help the physician diagnose the condition accurately.
words.example_uz: Qon tahlillari shifokorga holatga aniq tashxis qoʻyishda yordam beradi.

words.example_en: An accurate diagnosis is the first step toward recovery.
words.example_uz: Aniq tashxis — sogʻayish sari qoʻyilgan birinchi qadamdir.

words.example_en: The doctor decided to prescribe rest and herbal tea.
words.example_uz: Shifokor tinch dam olish va giyohli choy tayinlashga qaror qildi.

words.example_en: A warm compress helped relieve the pain in his neck.
words.example_uz: Issiq kompress uning boʻynidagi ogʻriqni yengillashtirishga yordam berdi.

words.example_en: Aloe gel helps soothe skin after too much sun.
words.example_uz: Aloe geli quyoshda koʻp yurgandan keyin terini tinchlantirishga yordam beradi.

words.example_en: Drink mineral water to hydrate your body after sports.
words.example_uz: Sportdan soʻng tanangizni suv bilan toʻyintirish uchun mineral suv iching.

words.example_en: Wholesome home-cooked soups nourish the body in winter.
words.example_uz: Uyda pishirilgan foydali shoʻrvalar qishda tanani oziqlantiradi.
